cases.description: Verify full journey: Launch, Onboarding, Sign Up, and Forgot Password flow
steps:
1. Tap app icon to launch. 
2. Observe ON_01A_Splash Screen. 
3. Complete onboarding steps (ON_01B to ON_01E). 
4. On ON_02A_Sign Up Options, tap "Sign up with Email". 
5. From the sign-up or login flow, navigate to and trigger the "Forgot password?" process.
cases.expected: App transitions through all screens, successfully arriving at ON_04B_Forgot Password - Entering Password.
